event.title: Andy Taylor, Duran Duran Guitarist, Passes Away at 65
event.canonical_title: Andy Taylor, Duran Duran Guitarist, Passes Away at 65
event.summary: Andy Taylor, the former guitarist of the band Duran Duran, has died at the age of 65. His passing follows a long and courageous battle with prostate cancer, as confirmed by the band.

timeline.title: Andy Taylor, Duran Duran Guitarist, Passes Away at 65
timeline.summary: Andy Taylor, the original guitarist of the iconic 1980s new wave band Duran Duran, has died at the age of 65 after a battle with stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer. His family and the band confirmed his passing, highlighting his contributions to the band's success with hits like 'Hungry Like the Wolf' and 'Rio.'
key_facts: Andy Taylor was the original guitarist of Duran Duran.
He died at the age of 65.
He battled stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer.
